claim_required: One unchanged executable observation-learning mechanism operates across at least three qualitatively unrelated natural interfaces.

candidate.title: DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning
candidate.headline_trigger: same Dreamer hyperparameters on four physical robots spanning locomotion, manipulation and navigation

rejection_reasons: continuous versus discrete action gradient branches
manual task rewards, coordinate actions, safety restrictions and navigation reward oracle
no all-robot world-model-disabled or frozen learned-factor ablation
no common full acquisition-to-reuse cost envelope
new_contract_anomaly: rule universality, representation transfer and foreign-source causal gain are distinct claims; recent NEXTAI cohorts heavily test the latter two while the fixed objective and G1 rule may only require the first plus causal gain in multiple families
next_cycle: Cross-ledger contract audit separating rule universality, representation transfer and foreign-source causal gain; admit a thesis only if a level-1 rule retained the same non-classical qualitative gain in at least two families at plausible full cost.
